messages:
jess: short q — for auto-fallback controls do we show separate p95 / error% or a single safety band?
ryan: separate. keeps signal visibility.
priya: separate + quick presets (conservative / balanced / aggressive) and an advanced panel.
leo: per-route presets are important (chat vs embeddings). defaults should inherit route type.
jess: proposed hosted defaults p95=400ms, error=0.8% — open to tweak.
ryan: add explicit list of counted error types in the UI (5xx, timeout, model_reject, kv_miss). avoids "why didn't it fallback" questions.
priya: preview idea: show estimated_switch_pct based on sampled telemetry (last 24-72h) with matched/total counts.
ops-bot: note: full scans are heavy. recommend default preview sample_pct=5% and capped windows.
leo: audit defaults: canary=10% capture, auto-fallback=1%. show cost estimate badge and privacy toggle for payload capture.
ryan: oscillation protection: debounce_ms + min_switch_interval + exponential backoff (10m, 30m, 2h).
jess: operator override flow: require reason + optional TTL, log audit event, show undo for 5m.
priya: rule authoring: boolean builder (status==500 OR contains(msg,"OOM") OR latency>1000) with live match preview and templates.
ops-bot: security: sandbox expressions, limit regex complexity, audit playback API access.
leo: playback API stub: GET /api/v1/rollouts/{id}/playback?from=&to=&sample_pct=&dry_run=1. require operator role.
jess: i'll mock UI: two inputs + presets, advanced builder, preview pane, hysteresis controls, audit toggles, override timeline. posting tomorrow AM.
priya: i'll add runbook checklist items and docs microcopy.
ryan: i'll add API spec and migration mapping for legacy rules.
ops-bot: scheduled: prototype review tomorrow 11:00am PT.
jess: thanks all :rocket:
